items.title: Connect a USB Zigbee Device to HAOS
items.summary_zh: 作者在 libvirt 虚拟机里跑 Home Assistant，插上 Zigbee USB 棒后界面里找不到它。他先用 lsusb 查到设备的 vendor 和 product ID，写一个 hostdev XML 文件，用 virsh attach-device 挂进虚拟机，再重启。能用之后，再加上 --persistent 参数，让直通在之后的重启中保留。
items.summary_en: The author could not see a Zigbee USB dongle in Home Assistant running as a libvirt VM. The fix is to find the device's USB vendor and product IDs with lsusb, write a hostdev XML file, and attach it with virsh attach-device, then reboot. Adding --persistent keeps the passthrough after later reboots.

items.title: Pluralistic: Lisa Hanawalt's "I Can't Stop Thinking About Horses and Sex" (20 Nov 2026)
items.summary_zh: Cory Doctorow 推荐 Lisa Hanawalt 的图文回忆录《I Can't Stop Thinking About Horses and Sex》。书里写她和喜剧演员 Adam Conover 分手的经过，她的马 Juni，还有约会、生育和肠道问题。他称赞这本书好笑又诚实，书中的人没有绝对的好坏。他还推荐 Conover 讲分手的喜剧专场当作搭配。
items.summary_en: Doctorow reviews Lisa Hanawalt's graphic memoir, which covers her breakup with comedian Adam Conover, her horse Juni, and her dating, fertility and IBS. He praises the book's humour and honesty, and says its characters are flawed without being simply good or bad. He also recommends Conover's breakup special as a companion piece.

items.title: Token fraud is here and it’s BAD (YouTube)
items.summary_zh: Simon Willison 转述 Claire Vo 的视频，她的 ChatPRD 因免费试用被大量滥用，有人拿来转卖 token 或在她的 agent 上做别的生意。Vo 决定取消所有免费试用。Willison 注意到，滥用者常用「鹈鹕骑自行车」的 SVG 提示词，他推测这可能用来探测背后是哪个模型家族，因为不同模型的输出风格有明显差异。
items.summary_en: Simon Willison shares Claire Vo's account of token fraud against ChatPRD, where people abused free trials to resell tokens or run other businesses on her agent. Vo is ending free trials entirely. Willison suspects the common pelican-on-a-bicycle SVG prompt is used to identify which model family sits behind the service, a trick he has used on stealth models.

items.title: Another company I've never heard of lost my Data
items.summary_zh: 作者收到一家他从没听说过的公司 Premise Health Holding 的通知信，说他的姓名、地址和社会安全号码在一名员工擅自改动客户数据期间受到影响。他从没和这家公司有过业务往来，不明白对方为什么有他的资料。他认为只给一年免费信用监控不够，除非数据丢失真的要付出代价，否则这种事会一直发生。
items.summary_en: The author got a breach notice from Premise Health Holding, a company he had never heard of, saying his name, address and Social Security number were affected by an employee's tampering with customer data. He has never done business with them and cannot see why they hold his information. He argues that a year of free credit monitoring is no real penalty, and that breaches will stay routine until losing data carries a real cost.

items.title: ★ Jon McCormack Retires From Apple
items.summary_zh: Gruber 根据 Bloomberg 的报道，说 Apple 相机和照片负责人 Jon McCormack 十月退休。他称赞 McCormack 技术功底深，也是 iPhone 17 Center Stage 自拍相机背后的推动者。他认为 McCormack 最重要的工作是把不成熟的点子挡在相机 App 之外。Gruber 还指出，Apple 在生成式 AI 修图上一直比较保守，但仍推出了 Clean Up 等功能。
items.summary_en: Gruber, citing Bloomberg, reports that Jon McCormack, the executive who oversaw Apple's Camera and Photos apps, retired in October. He praises McCormack's technical depth and his push for the iPhone 17 selfie camera, and argues his most valuable work was keeping weak ideas out of the Camera app. Gruber notes Apple remains conservative on generative AI photo editing, though it still ships features like Clean Up.

items.title: Google’s Spark AI Agent Becomes ‘Tasks’
items.summary_zh: 据 The Verge 报道，Google 把 AI 代理 Spark 改名为 Tasks 并免费开放，背后是它称为 Gemini 4 Hydrogen 的新模型。它能做餐单、管理日历、从邮件里找出可能不需要的定期扣费，美国用户还能让它打电话比价、用 Google Pay 买东西。Gruber 主要吐槽这个名字和已有的 Google Tasks 待办应用撞车。
items.summary_en: According to The Verge, Google renames its Spark AI agent to Tasks and makes it free, powered by a model called Gemini 4 Hydrogen. It can plan meals, manage calendars and find recurring charges in email, and US users can have it call businesses about prices and buy items with Google Pay. Gruber mainly mocks the name, which clashes with the existing Google Tasks to-do app.

items.title: PostgreSQL 19 Released
items.summary_zh: PostgreSQL 19 新增 WAIT FOR LSN 命令，备库上的会话可以先等到某个 WAL 位置回放完成，再执行查询。应用在主库写入后记下 LSN，之后的读请求先等备库追上，用户就能读到自己刚写的数据。Willison 认为这种「读己所写」的做法很实用，并指出维基百科的 MediaWiki 在 MySQL 复制上也有类似实现。
items.summary_en: PostgreSQL 19 adds WAIT FOR LSN, which lets a standby session wait until replay reaches a given WAL position before it reads. An application can record the LSN after a write and wait for it on later reads, so users see their own changes. Willison points out that MediaWiki has built a similar approach on MySQL replication.

items.title: Breaking: It doesn’t look Anthropic’s IPO is going to save the tech industry
items.summary_zh: Gary Marcus 的文章标题认为 Anthropic 的 IPO 救不了科技业。开头说，不少科技业人士希望它的上市能提振低迷的科技市场，开盘时科技股确实普遍上涨。正文写到 Anthropic 开盘后几小时正式上市，之后内容就中断了，所以看不到作者完整的论证。
items.summary_en: Marcus's post argues that Anthropic's IPO will not save the tech industry. It opens by noting that many in tech hoped the listing would lift a declining market, and that tech stocks rose at the open. The text cuts off as it describes Anthropic's debut, so his full argument is not in the excerpt.

items.title: Grand Theft Auto 6
items.summary_zh: The Verge 的文章认为《GTA 6》等这么久是值得的。文章先回顾《GTA V》超过两亿三千万份的销量和它对开放世界的影响，再说续作的热度因为泄露和延期而被进一步放大。Gruber 转发这篇文章，并说他儿子午夜发售后就在玩，觉得画面和乐趣都很好。
items.summary_en: The Verge piece argues that GTA VI was worth the long wait despite leaks and delays. It recalls that GTA V sold over 230 million copies and that the sequel stands out in a struggling game industry. Gruber shares it and says the game looks great and is fun.

items.title: Closing The Sandwich Shop
items.summary_zh: 作者为 Salon 停刊写了一篇悼念文章。他认为数字新闻业长期依赖平台、搜索和社交媒体这些自己控制不了的东西，Salon 在 2011 年关掉自己的评论社区就是个例子。文章还提到 Salon 被一家和线上赌博、加密货币有关的公司收购，作者怀疑对方要的是它的搜索排名，而不是新闻本身。
items.summary_en: The Tedium piece mourns the shutdown of Salon and argues that digital news has long depended on platforms and trends it does not control. Salon gave up its own comment community in 2011, which the author sees as a costly mistake. The author suspects the buyer, a company tied to online gambling and crypto, wanted Salon's search ranking more than its journalism.

items.title: Anthropic IPOs, Topping SpaceX for the Largest Ever
items.summary_zh: Gruber 对 Anthropic 的 IPO 持怀疑态度。他认为大语言模型没有长久的护城河，现在的领先只是前沿阶段的暂时优势，而且这股热潮被 Nvidia 推动，有泡沫的成分。他还认为这家公司的领导层不适合管理一家上市公司。
items.summary_en: Gruber is skeptical of the Anthropic IPO. He argues that LLMs have no lasting moat, only a temporary lead at the frontier inflated by a bubble that Nvidia helped pump up. He also doubts the company's leadership is fit to run a public company.

items.title: My Least Favorite Example in Software Engineering
items.summary_zh: Hillel Wayne 批评property-based testing 里很常见的例子，也就是把列表反转两次再比较是否相等。他认为这个例子能说明这种测试是什么，却和真实工作里的测试脱节，学生学不到什么有用的东西。他还追溯到 Manna、Boyer 和 Moore 以及 Bird 与 Wadler 都用过这个例子，但他们是拿来证明程序性质，直到 John Hughes 才把它用在测试上。
items.summary_en: Hillel Wayne argues that the common property-based testing example of reversing a list twice is a poor teaching example. It shows what the technique is but not why it matters in real testing. He traces the example to earlier proof-oriented work by Manna, Boyer and Moore, and Bird and Wadler, before John Hughes used it for testing.

items.title: Pluralistic: How to forfeit one of copyright's best labor policies (19 Nov 2026)
items.summary_zh: 作者认为过去五十年版权不断扩张，受益的主要是少数大型媒体公司，因为这些买家会在合同里要求创作者把新增的权利一起交出去。他举的例子是“终止转让”，即作品授权 35 年后创作者可以收回权利，这是少数被证明确实帮到创作者的机制。文章在讨论 1976 年版权法的原始草案时被截断，后面的内容没有看到。
items.summary_en: The author argues that copyright expansion has mostly helped large media companies, since they make creators hand over new rights in their contracts. He points to termination of transfer, which lets creators reclaim rights after 35 years, as one of the few provisions that has clearly helped artists. The post cuts off while discussing the original draft of the 1976 Copyright Act.

items.title: Theatre Review: FORT – a new opera ★★★☆☆
items.summary_zh: 这是一篇三星的剧评，评的是一部新的单幕歌剧《FORT》，在很小的场地里免费演出。评论者称赞两位歌唱家的功力，也很欣赏手风琴演奏者一个人营造出的整体声音氛围。不过乐谱偏简单，旋律少，唱念来回显得重复，而 75 分钟里塞进了太多情节，显得拥挤。
items.summary_en: A three-star review of FORT, a new one-act opera performed for free in a tiny venue. The reviewer praises both singers and the accordionist, who creates a full soundscape alone. But the score feels basic and repetitive, and the 75-minute show packs in too many plot points.

important.why_zh: Anthropic上市是AI行业的重大事件。
important.why_en: Anthropic's record IPO is major AI industry news, and Gruber offers a skeptical take on it.

important.why_zh: 令牌欺诈揭示了AI服务面临的滥用风险。
important.why_en: Token fraud against an AI product exposes a real abuse problem for AI services and free trials.

important.why_zh: 谷歌把AI代理免费开放，值得关注。
important.why_en: Google makes its AI agent free and lets it call businesses and buy items, a notable step for consumer agents.

liked.why_zh: 读己之写的复制机制与数据基础设施相关。
liked.why_en: Read-your-writes replication in PostgreSQL 19 is relevant to data infrastructure.

liked.why_zh: 属性测试的教学思考，适合工程实践。
liked.why_en: It rethinks how property-based testing is taught, which is useful for ML and software engineering practice.
